thread:
incident-bot: PAGED: multigpu collective failure on cluster ml-prod-9 (severity: P1). Automatic fallback attempted but some jobs are stuck in rendezvous. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.io/multigpu-collective

oncall_anna: Acked. I'm on it — grabbing node/pod info.

runtime_lead_jihoon: Sending quick context: we've seen increased AllReduce timeouts on pipeline-parallel workloads at 11:02 UTC; NCCL reports communicator errors and one pod restarted. Suspect OOM on one rank causing communicator to stall.

oncall_anna: kubectl -n ml get pods -o wide | grep ml-infer
oncall_anna: ```
ml-infer-7f8c9   2/2 Running  0  11m  10.1.3.45  node-09
ml-infer-8a2b1   1/2 CrashLoop 3  9m  10.1.3.46  node-12
ml-infer-9d3f0   2/2 Running  0  12m  10.1.3.47  node-11
```

oncall_anna: nvidia-smi on node-12 shows one GPU at 100% mem and a recent process exit. dmesg shows a GPU fault.

runtime_lead_jihoon: Logs from the crashed pod (excerpt):
runtime_lead_jihoon: ```
[11:01:44] NCCL ERROR NET/Unrecoverable: Rank 1 fatal error, aborting.
[11:01:44] NCCL WARN Allreduce timed out at step 54, peers: 0,1,2,3
[11:01:44] runtime: failed to allocate scratch buffer: cudaErrorMemoryAllocation
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::bad_alloc'
Aborted (core dumped)
```

ml_infra_paul: Confirming: node-12 shows kernel log XID 34 (gpu reset) and driver reported a memory leak in that container. It's not a network partition — it's a local GPU OOM/reset.

oncall_anna: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) cordon node-12 2) evict ML pods on node-12 3) restart runtime-gpu pods with smaller batch size variant and single-GPU fallback 4) update router to avoid node-12 until fully recovered.

oncall_anna: ```
kubectl cordon node-12
kubectl drain node-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force
# restart problematic deployment with env override BATCH_SIZE=1
kubectl -n ml set env deployment/ml-infer BATCH_SIZE=1 --record
kubectl rollout restart deployment/ml-infer
```

support_anya: Heads-up for customer comms: a subset of inference requests in eu-west were seeing increased latency and failed responses starting 11:00-11:05 UTC. Draft message for customers: "We're investigating degraded multi-GPU inference in eu-west; traffic is being shifted to fallback single-GPU nodes to restore availability. Some requests may see higher latency. We'll update in 30 mins." Want SRE confirmation before sending.

runtime_lead_jihoon: Agreed. Also enable automatic fallback policy for pipeline jobs for the next 2 hours: set routing weight to prefer single-gpu variants. Command:
runtime_lead_jihoon: ```
# pseudo-command for router update
redwood-router update --selector="model:ml-large,env:prod" --fallback=single-gpu --weight=0.9 --ttl=2h
```

ml_infra_paul: I'll apply a temporary node taint to prevent scheduling GPU-heavy training jobs to node-12 while we investigate driver logs.

oncall_anna: Doing the node actions now. cordon done. starting drain -> eviction succeeded for ml-infer-8a2b1. Restarting deployment with reduced batch size.

oncall_anna: rollout restarted; new pods coming up on node-11 and node-09. Initial healthchecks passing.

incident-bot: NOTE: Pager state set to acknowledged by oncall_anna at 11:07:12 UTC.

support_anya: Draft approved. Sending customer notice.

customer_ops_bot: Customer notification sent to affected tenants (ticket auto-created). Ticket IDs: C-98721, C-98722.

runtime_lead_jihoon: After restart we saw no repeated XID entries in the driver logs on the new nodes. Patch hypothesis: a memory leak or a particular batch/prefix causing extra KV cache pressure on rank 1. We'll capture a heap/profile from the next job.

ml_infra_paul: Collected core and nvprof from the crashed container; uploading to internal bucket: s3://redwood-logs/incidents/4801234567/

oncall_anna: Monitoring latency and error rates. At 11:18 UTC error rate dropped to baseline and node-12 remains cordoned. We're keeping fallback routing for 2 hours.

runtime_lead_jihoon: Post-incident actions: 1) deeper memory profiling of model run to reproduce OOM 2) run KV cache pressure tests 3) add a conservative memory headroom check in runtime to preemptively reject dangerously large batches 4) consider guarded rollout for the next model version.

support_anya: I'll follow up with customers with a technical summary once we have the root cause.

oncall_anna: Closing pager for now; final status: partial customer impact (elevated latency + some failures) mitigated by single-GPU fallback and node cordon. Will keep oncall handoff note for next shift. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident closed to triage state at 11:25:39 UTC.
